positions.title: Master of Science, Cloud Computing
description: MSc focused on cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations on AWS.
Research project: CloudShield-Federated. a self-adaptive federated learning system deployed across multiple AWS EC2 instances using Python, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn.
Applied KMeans clustering to group clients by computational capacity, improving F1 score from 89.7% to 90.0% compared to non-clustered baseline.
